featured_reviews.name: Khan Asim
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is by far the worst decision I’ve ever made for my education. If you are considering the BCA or BBA courses here, please read this before you throw your money away.
The Affiliation Trap (YCMOU Nashik)
The college markets these courses aggressively, but they fail to mention the nightmare that comes with the Yashwantrao Chavan Maharashtra Open University (YCMOU) affiliation.
Zero Coordination: There is a massive gap between the college management and the University in Nashik. For any small issue—be it hall tickets, marksheet errors, or exam dates—the college staff simply shrugs and tells you to "contact Nashik directly."
Outdated Curriculum: The BCA and BBA syllabus through this affiliation feels like it’s from the 1990s. It is completely irrelevant to today’s corporate world or the IT industry.
Management & Faculty Issues
Unprofessional Staff: The administration is extremely unhelpful and often rude. They treat students like they are doing them a favor by letting them study there.
Teaching Quality: For professional courses like BCA, you expect high-end labs and industry-ready faculty. Instead, we get teachers who just read from PPTs and have no practical knowledge of the subjects.
Placement Lies: They promise "100% placement assistance," but when you actually reach the final year, you realize that most reputable companies don't even recognize these open-university affiliated degrees from this center.
Final Verdict
Don't be fooled by the building or the "Bunts Sangha" name. This specific program is a degree mill designed to take your fees while giving you zero value in return. If you want a real career in Management or IT, look for a college affiliated with the University of Mumbai or a reputed autonomous institute.
Save your future and stay away!

featured_reviews.review_text:
I enrolled in this college for my MCA degree. While my initial expectations were not that great from this college but the experience completely blew me away. As an Alumni from RD.National & MMK College, I can say that Hiray college has been one of the best experiences of my life.

Teaching Staff: The teaching staff of MCA is its true asset. They are extremely knowledgeable & have in field experience. They help you in every step of the way whether it be curriculum or with building confidence. I was working night shifts all while graduation & would often lag behind other students in my league & the support & help I got from the teaching staff is innumerable. Not just that the teaching staff are very motivational & never turn a student away who ask for help. That doesn't mean the students get leeway since the professors know when to act strict when they have to.

Campus & Auditorium:  While the campus is small & its nothing to rave about but the faculty makes sure how to utilize every corner of it to its advantage. The annual college event & the seminars truly come alive in this setting. I highly recommend watching videos of college fest on youtube. This is a great example of where less is more.

Classrooms, Lab & Library: The classrooms are mediocre to say the least but the computer laboratory is one of the best. You can find a large number of books in the library which you can borrow (2 at a time limit)

Placement: A large number of companies come every year to recruit students. The placement in charge does a phenomenal work. In my 3 years in this college I haven't seen a single student who hasn't been recruited with the only exception being students having live KT.

Overall Experience: My expectations were truly transcended. With a great teaching staff & good track record of placements it will be a mistake if you don't choose this college.

I would definitely recommend anyone who asks.

featured_reviews.name: YAGYA GARG
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely disgraceful, negligent, and shameful experience at the ICAI BKC Branch.

This has been one of the most frustrating and mentally exhausting experiences I have ever faced. I call this branch 20–25 times every single day, and not once do they answer. There is no callback, no follow-up, no response of any kind. The phones might as well not exist.

I have also sent more than 10 emails, clearly explaining my issue and requesting help. Not a single email has been replied to. No acknowledgment, no update, no courtesy. Just complete silence.

This total lack of communication creates massive uncertainty for students. Important academic decisions are put on hold because this branch simply refuses to respond. It is impossible to plan anything when the branch behaves like this.

What makes this even worse is that for a simple process like batch cancellation, students are being forced to travel long distances to the branch in person, instead of resolving it over a call or online. This is despite the fact that official ICAI guidelines clearly state that such processes can be done online by mailing to the branch. This shows sheer laziness, incompetence, and complete disregard for students’ time, money, and effort.

For an ICAI branch, this level of unprofessionalism is shocking. The staff appears utterly incompetent — either unwilling or incapable of answering basic calls or replying to simple emails. There seems to be no trained, responsible, or capable staff handling student queries.

This branch is poorly managed, unaccountable, and completely unreliable. ICAI seriously needs to intervene and change the staff or management of this branch, because the current setup is a complete failure and an embarrassment to the institute.

Extremely frustrating, highly unprofessional, and unacceptable. This branch does not deserve to represent ICAI.

So much of negative memories in this branch 😑

featured_reviews.name: Saurabh Jadhav
featured_reviews.review_text:
A Transformative Journey at MET IIT, Bandra: Crafting Success in the Tech World

As a student pursuing my CDAC diploma at MET IIT  Mumbai, my academic journey has been nothing short of enriching and transformative. I, Saurabh Shahaji Jadhav, am delighted to share my experiences, which have been shaped by the dedicated faculty, robust curriculum, and a supportive community at MET IIT.

One of the pivotal factors contributing to the success of my academic journey has been the remarkable team of instructors at MET IIT. Under the guidance of Mr. Nilesh Shirke sir, our respectable course coordinator, the CDAC program has been precisely designed to equip us with the skills and knowledge essential for a successful career in the dynamic world of technology.

The faculty members, each a specialist in their respective fields, have played a crucial role in enhancing our skills. Mr. Hussain sir's insightful teachings in Java and Dotnet, Mr. Amar sir's expertise in C++ and Data Structures, and Rahul Barve sir's comprehensive coverage of J2EE have provided a solid foundation in programming and software development. Girish Godbole sir's guidance in Software Development Methodologies (SDM) and Jigar Sir's expertise in Web Programming Technology have been instrumental in broadening my horizons.

Special mention must be made for Priti Dalavi Ma'am, whose expertise in Database Management Structure has not only made the subject intriguing but also laid the groundwork for understanding the backbone of modern applications.

Beyond the classroom, the support system at MET IIT extends to the mentorship program. I am fortunate to have Mayank Gupta, a seasoned alumnus, as my mentor. His insights and guidance have been invaluable, providing me with a roadmap for success in the tech industry.

What sets MET IIT apart is not just the curriculum and faculty but the encouraging atmosphere that fosters growth. The college has instilled in me the confidence to dive headfirst into the placement process. The faculty members, including Mr. Shirke sir and my mentor Mayank Gupta, have been unwavering pillars of support, assuring me that my efforts will be met with success.

As I stand on the brink of entering the professional realm, I am confident that the strong foundation laid at MET IIT, combined with the support of the exceptional faculty and mentorship program, will pave the way for a fulfilling and rewarding career. I express my gratitude to MET IIT for shaping me into a confident and competent individual ready to contribute to the ever-evolving world of technology.

A big thank you to the MET CDAC team and Mr. Nilesh Shirke sir for this remarkable journey! 🌈 Proud to be part of Mumbai Educational Trust, MET League of Colleges. 🏛 #METIITCDAC #GratitudePost
